title: Require proof sufficiency for every affected owner

intent.outcome: Proof decisions retain every affected semantic owner and block sufficiency when its current owner-maintained acceptance evidence is missing.
non_goals: Leave adjacent backlog or follow-on work out of this plan.

owned: Make matched subsystem ownership participate in proof coverage even when no proof command is declared.
Declare the repository's maintained package acceptance gates on the existing subsystem owners.
Add regressions for missing owner proof and overlapping feature/owner routes.
effects: A matched subsystem without current proof becomes an explicit owner coverage gap.
Focused feature routes cannot suppress distinct owner-maintained acceptance gates.
Unaffected package owners remain absent from proof selection.
